SELF_AUDIT.SCALABILITY: Below quality 0.3 the equipment cadence approaches MaximumTickInterval 0.2 seconds, ambient sampling collapses toward nearest thermal cell, and cooling math uses the low LOD scalar. The legacy voxel provider is inert, so low tier does not pay physics voxelization or texture upload cost. At quality 1.0 cadence approaches 0.016 seconds, thermal-grid sampling blends into trilinear, and shader flicker keeps the richer volumetric/silt/shaft modulation. DTO layout, save identity, and SignalBus authority are unchanged.
SELF_AUDIT.H_PHI_VAULT_STATUS: Runtime integration declares no new private NativeArray ownership. The previous flashlight voxel provider private native buffers were removed from runtime by converting that component to an inert legacy facade. PlayerFlashlight no longer implements IUpdatable or ITickable and does not register with the update dispatcher; its remaining presentation shell is owner-called by ModularEquipmentEngine. FlashlightEvents no longer owns private NativeQueue storage; its 16-byte payloads use the typed SignalBus lane FLEV and a listener compatibility bridge over frame snapshots with a per-generation dispatch cursor. Vault lanes used: 71300 ActiveEquipmentState, 71301 PublishedState, 71302 AupSamples, 71303 GridLoadRequests, 71304 EquipmentTelemetryRing, 71305 EquipmentTelemetryCursor, 71306 IntegrationCounters, 71308 Tuning, 71309 HardwareSpecs, 71311 ToolStates, 71312 ToolStats, 71313 ToolTypes, 71314 StatusMasks, 71315 EnvironmentHeat01, 71316 WearDrainRates, 71317 FlashlightTelemetryRing, 71318 FlashlightTelemetryCursor.
SELF_AUDIT.POINTER_ALIASING_AND_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH: EquipmentStateIntegrationJob consumes inputDeps and outputs _equipmentIntegrationHandle registered with H8Memory. NoAlias pointers: Equipment, ToolStates, Stats, ToolAups, WearDrainRates, ThermalGrid, GridLoadRequests, Counters. Overheat/depletion writers use typed NativeQueue ParallelWriter lanes; flashlight presentation events use SignalBus<FlashlightEventPayload> snapshots. ModularEquipmentEngine completes the equipment job at its documented late-frame owner fence, then calls active/enabled PlayerFlashlight.StepFromEquipmentOwner and publishes owner shader globals. No independent flashlight dispatcher update remains; cold mock/clear paths still use explicit forced completion before publication.
